body.heading: Pick your letter
paragraphs: Choose a letter together, like B. Say its sound out loud: buh.
Write the letter big at the top of your page. This is your treasure map.

body.heading: Find the treasure
paragraphs: Walk slowly and look. Ball! Banana! Book! Each thing you find that starts with the sound goes on your list.
Count your treasures at the end. Try a harder letter tomorrow.

takeaway: Letters are hiding at the start of words all around your home.
safetyNotes: Hunt only in rooms and places your adult says are fine.
